_comment: root_sink generic event definition (--event-def / TOML event_def_file, TODO 71) for the ThGEM setup, single digitizer = module 0: ThGEM1 (ch1) and ThGEM2 (ch6) are the triggers, ThGEM1 is the preferred reference of a group.
All times are on the ALIGNED axis: config/time_settings_thgem.json is applied first, so the window is around the aligned reference trigger time.
The ThGEM delay-line arms arrive ~+20..+260 ns after their trigger and the LaBr3 ~70..190 ns before it, so +-1000 ns covers them. group_ns must stay <= min(pre, post).
